apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.13 — Dynamic note blending: swaras ring into each other in proportion to tempo and speed (30% of the step), and the harmonium release is proportional and cosine-shaped — slow Varisai at 1x no longer falls silent between notes. Also carries v1.5.12 (LoopLab parity: flat steppers, web new-group flow, waveform fit-on-select), v1.5.11 (single-playback funnel) and v1.5.10 (editor Cancel).
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
